scripts.dev: node -e "import('node:http').then(({createServer})=>import('node:fs').then(({readFile})=>import('node:path').then(({extname,join})=>{const m={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'application/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json; charset=utf-8','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};createServer((q,s)=>{const u=(q.url||'/').split('?')[0];const p=u==='/'?'index.html':u.replace(/^\/+/, '');readFile(join(process.cwd(),p),(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);s.end('Not found');return;}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[extname(p)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(d);});}).listen(3000,'0.0.0.0');})))"
